limitations: Sample-level style acceptance does not establish full inventory style or linguistic correctness.
Whole-field here uses inventory source samples and catches geometric interactions; it is not universal script sentence validation.
App routing, layout and browser/export are not executed.
Known field-guard failures remain scoped gaps; no silent fallback counted as completed pressure.
